item.title: 50/50 Bachata & Salsa on Thursdays — Thu Sep 10, 7:00 PM — Neruda’s Brunswick
item.description:
Spring has sprung! Let’s dance! Showy Dance Melbourne & Neruda Brunswick joined forces to bring a night for Bachata & Salsa class + a Social dance night! Every Thursday from 7 pm. 7 pm: Bachata class. 8 pm: Salsa class. 9 pm: Social night. After the 2 classes finished, we will continue the night with Social dance. Neruda Brunswick is a Latino American restaurant located in Brunswick. Address: 66 Breese St, Brunswick. Both of our classes will be Open level. Cost of the class: 1 class $20.- 2 classes $30.- After the classes you can stay for the Social night to practice the steps that you learnt in class or just mingle enjoying the vibes and the Latin atmosphere of Neruda Brunswick. Any question: Just give us a call: 0431 037 786. email: showydancemelbourne@gmail.com See you on the dance floor!! …….

item.description: Welcome to Pontoon Salsa Thursdays! Get ready to spice up your Thursday nights with the hottest Latin dance party in town! Experience required. Drink Specials: $7.50 Coronas and $25 Sangria jugs to share with friends! $10 Pizzas: Refuel with mouthwatering pizzas to keep you energised all night. Music rotation: 2 x Salsa, 2 x Bachata, and 1 x Latino anthem. Curated Music: Our DJs will keep the dance floor moving with specially selected Salsa and Bachata for dancers. item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Sep 10, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Série Portraits et autoportraits: De la légitimation du pouvoir à l’affirmation du savoir — Sat Sep 19, 2:00 PM
item.description: Les effigies royales répondent, sous l’Ancien Régime, à de stricts codes de représentation, en mettant l’accent sur des attributs (couronne, épée, sceptre, main de justice, etc.) qui en légitiment visuellement le pouvoir. Avec l’affirmation au XVIIIe siècle de « l’Esprit des Lumières », les peintres insistent désormais, pour portraiturer les philosophes (Diderot, Rousseau, Voltaire) ou les scientifiques (Buffon, Lavoisier, Pasteur), sur ce qui fonde leur savoir (livre, instruments scientifiques, etc.). Ces détails iconographiques, en apparence anodins, traduisent en réalité le basculement d’une société à une autre ! Cette conférence vous est proposée par Gilles Genty, historien de l’art, en partenariat avec l’ Alliance française de Toronto . Accessibilité: Le sous-titrage en direct ou automatique, l’interprétation en langue des signes, les services d’intervenant, ou les services d’accompagnement sont disponibles sur demande. item.title: Modernizing Java Applications using GitHub Copilot Modernization Agent — Tue Sep 22, 1:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto Modernization backlogs continue to grow as organizations face technical debt, framework upgrades, cloud migrations, and architectural change across their Java application portfolios.
In this session, learn how GitHub Copilot Modernization Agent analyzes applications, identifies modernization opportunities, generates migration plans, and accelerates code transformation.
Through live demos, see how organizations can modernize Java applications faster, reduce manual effort, and move from legacy systems to cloud and AI-ready architectures with greater confidence.
Key Takeaway: Agentic AI is changing the economics of modernization, enabling organizations to tackle larger application portfolios and accelerate AI transformation at scale.
Source: Meetup: Microsoft Reactor Toronto
